verdict.rationale: Forter documents an official MCP server that lets an AI system review decisions and manage disputes through natural-language commands, and it can be connected to Claude Desktop. That is a plausible base for an agent to work cases. Separately, Forter's own recommendation engine suggests evidence for disputes, but the docs do not show an agent pulling a queue of flagged cases with full context or proposing approve/decline for a human to confirm. Missing for 10: a documented review-queue or flagged-case retrieval tool, case-context and evidence-summarization capabilities, an agent decision-recommendation flow with human confirmation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
